findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "draft_broadcast" stacks urgency/override words (never, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: route_request, intake_estimate, draft_broadcast · Private data: route_request · Public sink: run_full_audit, intake_estimate, draft_broadcast · Destructive: run_full_audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: route_request, intake_estimate, draft_broadcast · Private data: route_request · Public sink: run_full_audit, intake_estimate, draft_broadcast · Destructive: run_full_audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
